en.Avec mon groupe, nous avons adapté le je: My group and I adapted the board game Concordia in Python. It runs in a Tkinter window against computer-controlled players, with cards, cities and routes loaded from an Oracle database.
en.Un projet qui réunit logique de jeu, int: A project combining game logic, a graphical interface and a database.
en.Un morpion où l’on affronte un programme: A tic-tac-toe game against a program that evaluates possible moves using Minimax. The Tkinter interface is separate from the decision logic to make the algorithm easier to follow.
en.Récursivité, simulation des coups et exp: Recursion, move simulation and search-tree exploration.
en.Un bot Python pour suivre l’activité d’u: A Python bot that tracks Discord server activity: messages, time in voice channels and member engagement. It provides profiles, rankings and charts, along with a message analysis module.
en.Les données sont stockées dans PostgreSQ: Data is stored in PostgreSQL using SQLAlchemy.
